 Not everything is in arm's reach. It always feels like your arm's length is just a few inches short from grabbing that box of cake mix from the top shelf of your cupboard or your favorite pair of sock that somehow ended up under your bed. With Luxet, those extra inches on your arm are here to stay with the brilliant long reach grabber tool! It even comes with a magnetic piece that functions to firmly secure metal items.A SAFE WAY TO GET WHAT YOU NEEDWhen things are too high, you may consider grabbing a chair to give you a boost but that's not always a good idea. Unstable stepping stools and ladders can lead to falls so you may need to consider other options. It's also great for picking up sharp shards or bacteria filled items.Get your extending grabbing arm tool today!
